description: Source code for managing device resources, including creation, cloning, JSON serialization/deserialization, and cleanup functions for icDeviceResource objects.

methods.name: resourceDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an icDeviceResource object and its fields.

methods.name: resourcePrint
methods.description: Logs details of an icDeviceResource object for debugging.

methods.name: resourceClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an icDeviceResource object.

methods.name: resourceToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an icDeviceResource object into a cJSON JSON representation.

methods.name: resourcesToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a list of icDeviceResource objects into a JSON object with resource IDs as keys.

methods.name: resourceFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into an icDeviceResource, loading resource data from JSON.

methods.name: resourcesFromJSON
methods.description: Loads multiple resources from a JSON array into a linked list of icDeviceResource objects.
